description: [phase 3.8 38h, kind `port`] showCharacterEditor's hair-style counter (control 10) is the frame dword [F+0x30], read before any write (0x00439b12 / 0x00439b29; c3fx notes, FINDINGS). The port starts it at 0 (the zeroed-stack convention, U-0880), so its negative-remainder arms (0x00439b1c / 0x00439b36 fall-through: 0xd0 / 0xe0 / 0xf0 into the record's +0x23 high nibble) never run; in the game the first press starts from whatever the stack held there
path to resolution: a trace that records the slot's value at the first press (the scenario stack seed fills only below courseActionMenu's entry), or a defect switch once the value is known; no COMMAND segment presses control 10

description: [phase 3.8 38h, kind `port`] the cursor slots only View_toLocal writes: showCharacterEditor's x [F+0x24] / y [F+0x1c] and pickCharEditor's x (its `push ecx` slot, which holds the caller's ecx, 0x00438390) and y (its argument slot: y starts as `row`, 0x004383b2..0x004383ca). With no display (g_graphicsDevice 0) the original keeps those values minus View::fromParent's offsets each pass; the port starts the editor's at 0 / 0 and the picker's at 0 / row. Every segment image has a display, and the oracle cases with no display never reach the picker
path to resolution: none needed while every run has a display

description: [phase 3.8 38h, kind `scope`] showCharacterEditor's bio entry (control 20 for a non-member, 0x00439dca..0x00439f43) is not ported: it builds the global EditBox g_characterEditorEditBox (EditBox::create, setText, resizeBuffer: heap), whose typed text arrives through the window tree's focus (EditBox::onKey), not through the root handlers, then copies the EditBox's text into the record's bio. The port throws MissingResource{"showCharacterEditor: the bio EditBox"} before any of its writes (the oracle stubs EditBox::create to stop there too); no COMMAND segment presses it
path to resolution: port the EditBox family (UI phase), then the loop showScreen / redrawAll / leaveModal483d80 / pumpMessages until a press or Enter

description: [phase 3.8 38h, kind `oracle`] the editor's oracle (port/test/test_chareditor.py) scripts four peers on both sides (listMatchingFiles, loadThemeFile, promptAndSaveFile: files; buildGolferComment: story text) and compares their call sequences; their own evidence is 38b / 3.1b / 3.5's. Because loadThemeFile is scripted, the figure's member-pro branch (preview kind 0x20, 0x00438a2b fall-through) is unexercised: the editor zeroes the preview kind at entry and only a real loadThemeFile on golfer 0x99 can set it again. composeGolferSprite runs for real (fake compositor object, part pointers NULL), because tick's addSprite also calls it
path to resolution: none needed unless a segment diverges inside the editor

description: [phase 3.8 38h, kind `port`] the editor's two release-wait loops (pumpMessages 0x0043a235 / 0x0043a24f) take a batch only when the source has one for that pump: in the oracle they are drains (nothing arrives), a trace-driven source delivers there only at the pass's cursor count, and after one refusal the port asks no more until the next cursor read (otherwise tick.cpp TraceInput's stuck rule, two refusals at one cursor count, would hand the next pass's batch to the second loop). The taken sides of 0x0043a241 / 0x0043a25b (a press arriving inside the release wait, which the original then swallows) are reached by no oracle case and no segment
path to resolution: a segment where a click arrives within the release wait (two presses inside one 10 ms window)
